tools.name: Read GitHub releases
tools.description: Reads the newest releases of a public GitHub repository.

tools.name: Read Maven Central and npm
tools.description: Reads every version a package has on Maven Central or npm, so the Version checker can find the newest. Only the Maven and npm packages on the Software watchlist.

tools.name: Look up known vulnerabilities in packages
tools.description: Finds known vulnerabilities in the version we run of each Maven or npm package in OSV, then reads each one's official score from NVD. Only the Maven and npm packages on the Software watchlist, and only a version someone gave.

tools.name: Search Jira
tools.description: Finds tickets in a Jira project by words, status, type, the day they were done, the day they were created or the day they were last updated. Each ticket comes with its type and assignee. A long list is cut at 50, and the agent says so.

tools.name: Create a Jira ticket
tools.description: Proposes a ticket. It is created only after an Approver approves it.
